vellum-sand.$description: Vellum Sand — Primary page canvas — the base warm-cream that fills every section, never competing with content

pressed-linen.$description: Pressed Linen — Secondary surface for subtle section breaks, link backgrounds, and content cards resting on Vellum Sand

aged-ink.$description: Aged Ink — Dominant text and hairline border color — near-black with a touch of warmth, used for 95% of all rules, headings, and body copy

charcoal-black.$description: Charcoal Black — Hard ink for display headings, icon fills, and the strongest contrast moments where absolute black reads better than warm

twilight-bronze.$description: Twilight Bronze — Gradient stop — the deepest tone in the vertical vellum wash, used only inside the hero gradient

hayfield.$description: Hayfield — Gradient midtone — the saturated middle of the vertical wash, gives the canvas its sun-warmed depth

wheat-sheaf.$description: Wheat Sheaf — Gradient light tone — the transition stop between the warm mid and the Vellum base

pp-neue-montreal.$description: The sole typeface across every screen. Body text sits at 16–20px weight 400; subheadings lift to 24–26px weight 500; display headlines scale dramatically from 75px through 122px to 158–173px at weight 500. The signature move is this extreme display scaling — the same family at 14px captions and 173px hero headlines proves the typeface can carry both whispered body copy and shouted editorial moments without switching personality.
